pause.label: Pause recording
pause.tooltip: Pause recording. The meeting won't end.

connection.bufferPaused: Recording paused while saving catches up. It resumes automatically.
connection.microphoneLost: Microphone disconnected. Audio isn't recorded until it reconnects.
connection.systemAudioLost: Computer audio disconnected. Other participants' audio isn't recorded until it reconnects.
connection.pendingOnDevice: {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of audio is waiting on this device. Keep this tab open until you reconnect.
connection.disconnected: Connection lost. Transcription and live analysis are paused. Recorded audio is held in this tab. Keep it open until you reconnect.

errorToast.quotaAskAdmin: Ask an admin to switch to Pro.

errors.quotaExceeded: You've used all of this month's free recording time.
errors.startFailed: Couldn't start recording. Try again in a moment.
errors.audioPermission: HeyMoa needs microphone or computer audio permission. Allow it, then record again.
errors.systemAudioMissing: Couldn't find computer audio input. Check the input and permissions, then record again.
errors.audioCaptureFailed: Couldn't connect audio. Check permissions and try again.
errors.microphonePermission: HeyMoa needs microphone access. Allow the microphone in your browser settings.
errors.microphoneMissing: Couldn't find a microphone to use.
errors.socketFailed: Couldn't connect to the live transcription server. Check that you're signed in and connected to the internet.
errors.activeSession: This meeting is being recorded in another tab or on another device.
errors.recorderDisconnected: Lost connection to the device that was recording. You can record again in about a minute.
errors.sessionCreateFailed: Couldn't prepare the transcription session. Try again in a moment.
errors.superseded: Another tab or device took over this recording.
errors.stopFailed: Something went wrong while stopping the recording.
errors.stopUnconfirmed: Couldn't confirm that the recording stopped.
errors.captureStopped: Audio capture stopped. The last part of the audio may not have been saved.
errors.captureStoppedToast: Audio capture stopped. Check the recording status.
errors.dropped: Recording stopped because the connection dropped.
errors.droppedLost: Recording stopped because the connection dropped. Couldn't upload {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of audio left on this device.
errors.stopTimeout: Couldn't save the last part of the audio. Try again in a moment.
errors.stopTimeoutLost: Couldn't save the last part, so {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of audio left on this device wasn't uploaded.
errors.serverError: The live transcription connection stopped. Try again in a moment.
errors.meetingEndedLost: The meeting ended, so {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} of audio left on this device couldn't be uploaded.

interrupted.MEETING_ENDED: The meeting ended, so recording finished.
interrupted.MEETING_PAUSED: The meeting was paused, so recording stopped.
interrupted.STT_PROVIDER_ERROR: The speech recognition service disconnected. Try again in a moment.
interrupted.CLIENT_DISCONNECTED: Recording stopped because the live connection closed.
interrupted.READY_TIMEOUT: The session expired before recording started. Try again.
interrupted.HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT: Recording stopped after being disconnected for too long.
interrupted.other: The server stopped the transcription session.
